events.title: NVIDIA makes CUDA 13.5 production-ready for Vera Rubin
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 用 CUDA 13.5 将 Vera Rubin 支持推向 GA
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released CUDA 13.5 with general-availability support for Vera Rubin. It adds finer MPS scheduling and cgroup routing, multi-GPU communication in CUDA Tile, batched copy support in CUDA Graphs and public previews for Tile-SIMT interoperation and always-on profiling. Some features remain previews and Rubin changes the supported Windows driver modes.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 CUDA 13.5，并将 Vera Rubin 支持推向 GA。该版加入更细的 MPS 调度与 cgroup 路由、CUDA Tile 多 GPU 通信、CUDA Graph 批量拷贝，以及 Tile-SIMT 互操作和常驻性能分析预览。部分能力仍是 preview，Rubin 的 Windows driver mode 也有变化。
events.why_it_matters_en: For infrastructure teams preparing Rubin, CUDA 13.5 is the production software baseline, but preview features and changed driver assumptions need explicit compatibility tests before rollout.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对准备 Rubin 的基础设施团队来说，CUDA 13.5 是生产软件基线；preview 能力和 driver 假设变化必须先做兼容性回归。

events.title: Ricursive releases Ripple-65B Preview under Apache 2.0
events.title_zh: Ricursive 以 Apache 2.0 发布 Ripple-65B Preview
events.summary: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense model with BF16, NVFP4 and base checkpoints under Apache 2.0. The company reports 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, a 1M-token context window and $32 million in total R&D cost. The model card says some comparisons use different harnesses and that reproducing agentic scores is difficult, so the headline ranking remains publisher-reported.
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating local coding models, a 65B Apache-2.0 checkpoint is materially easier to test than larger open-weight peers, but harness-sensitive benchmarks and custom code require direct reproduction before selection.
events.summary_zh: Ricursive Intelligence 发布 Ripple-65B Preview，这是一个 65B dense model，提供 BF16、NVFP4 与 base checkpoint，采用 Apache 2.0。公司报告 TerminalBench 2.1 为 80.52、上下文窗口 1M token、总研发成本 3,200 万美元。model card 承认部分对比采用不同 harness，agentic 分数也难复现，因此头部排名仍是厂商自报。
events.summary_en: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense model with BF16, NVFP4 and base checkpoints under Apache 2.0. The company reports 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, a 1M-token context window and $32 million in total R&D cost. The model card says some comparisons use different harnesses and that reproducing agentic scores is difficult, so the headline ranking remains publisher-reported.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估本地 coding model 的团队来说，65B、Apache 2.0 的 checkpoint 比超大模型更容易试验；harness 敏感的 benchmark 与 custom code 仍要求直接复现。

events.title: OpenAI signs an agreement to acquire Pierre Computer Company
events.title_zh: OpenAI 签署收购 Pierre Computer Company 的协议
events.summary: OpenAI announced an agreement to acquire Pierre Computer Company, whose Trees and Diffs libraries already power file browsing and change review in Codex. OpenAI says Pierre’s open-source projects will remain open and Code Storage customers can continue using the service. The transaction has not closed and remains subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.
events.why_it_matters: For Codex users and developer-tool builders, the agreement points to deeper Git storage and review integration, but it creates no completed ownership or immediate availability change until closing and product delivery.

events.title: llama-modchip claims CPU-only inference for a 284B model on 64 GB RAM
events.title_zh: llama-modchip 声称 64 GB 内存可用 CPU 跑 284B 模型
events.published_at_note: GitHub shows the v2.4.0 release at 2026-11-04 00:24 UTC; seconds are unavailable, so the event retains date precision.
events.summary: llama-modchip publishes code, binaries and compressed weights for CPU-only local inference. Its maintainer reports fitting a 284B DeepSeek model in about 57.6 GiB and decoding at roughly 9–11 tokens per second without a GPU. The project uses a custom tensor format and runtime. The performance and quality claims have not been independently reproduced.
events.why_it_matters: For local-inference teams, the claimed memory reduction would materially change workstation deployment if it survives independent tests. Today the custom format, limited adoption and maintainer-only benchmarks make migration risk higher than the evidence supports.
events.summary_zh: llama-modchip 发布了 CPU-only 本地推理代码、二进制和压缩权重。维护者报告称，284B DeepSeek 模型约占 57.6 GiB 内存，无 GPU 解码约为每秒 9–11 token。项目使用自定义 tensor 格式与运行时。性能和质量主张尚未得到独立复现。
events.summary_en: llama-modchip publishes code, binaries and compressed weights for CPU-only local inference. Its maintainer reports fitting a 284B DeepSeek model in about 57.6 GiB and decoding at roughly 9–11 tokens per second without a GPU. The project uses a custom tensor format and runtime. The performance and quality claims have not been independently reproduced.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地推理团队来说，如果独立测试成立，这种内存压缩会明显改变工作站部署方式。但目前自定义格式、有限采用与维护者自测带来的迁移风险高于证据强度。
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-inference teams, the claimed memory reduction would materially change workstation deployment if it survives independent tests. Today the custom format, limited adoption and maintainer-only benchmarks make migration risk higher than the evidence supports.
